answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% of committed volume, continuity has unusually high value and migration or supplier qualification risk is not justified by the available evidence. Verify incumbent delivery stability and prior renewal-negotiation results, then use market benchmarks, volume commitments, and payment terms to pursue the mandated cost reduction while retaining supply continuity. The 18% target may not be fully achievable through negotiation alone, so avoid representing it as assured.
